        Annual Maintenance Contracts

        Plans and prices, quotations and activation, preventive visits and free services, billing, renewals – and service execution through Helpdesk, Service Job and Field Service.

        amc_management 18.0.1.1.0Warranty LinkService Execution37 screenshots

        1. Introduction#

        The AMC Management application manages Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) separately from the warranty card: plans and prices, quotations and activation, preventive visits and included free services, billing, renewals and closure. AMC visits are carried out through the same Helpdesk Ticket → Service Job → Field Service process as warranty services.

        1.1 Modules#

        ModuleWhat it adds
        AMC ManagementPlans, pricing formulas, opportunities, contracts, quotations, AMC visits, billing schedule, renewals, AMC Visit Schedule report
        AMC Management – Warranty LinkDraft AMC after warranty confirmation, Convert to AMC, warranty units on the covered equipment, offer AMC when a warranty expires
        AMC Management – Service ExecutionService requests from AMC visits: Helpdesk ticket, AMC warranty case, Service Job, Field Service visit, worksheet and customer sign-off

        1.2 Roles#

        RoleCan do
        AMC UserView plans, contracts and visits; prepare Draft opportunities and contracts; Convert to AMC
        AMC CoordinatorEverything of the User + calculate prices, request overrides, create quotations, create invoices, plan visits, create service requests, renew contracts
        AMC ManagerEverything of the Coordinator + configure plans, billing plans and formulas, cancel / hold / resume / close contracts, cancel or reopen visits
        AMC ApproverApprove or reject price / pricelist overrides (never their own requests)
        Helpdesk user / TechnicianProcess the AMC case and Service Job; complete the Field Service visit with the customer sign-off
        AccountantPost AMC invoices and register payments (standard Accounting)

        1.3 The AMC process at a glance#

        1. Configure the AMC plan, its pricing formula and billing plan.
        2. Create an AMC contract (manually, from an opportunity, or from a warranty card).
        3. Price and quote – calculate the price and create the standard quotation.
        4. Activate – on Sales Order confirmation or when the first invoice is paid.
        5. Service – the preventive visits and free services are generated; each visit is executed through Helpdesk → Service Job → Field Service.
        6. Bill – billing periods are released on schedule and invoiced with the standard invoicing.
        7. Renew or close – the contract becomes Expiring before its end date, is renewed or closed.

        2. Configuration (AMC Manager)#

        2.1 AMC settings#

        Open AMC Management > Configuration > Settings (administrators only). The settings apply to the current company. The "Default …" values are only proposed for records created afterwards: existing plans and contracts keep their own values.

        SettingWhat it does
        AMC EnabledMarks that the company works with AMC. Informational only: it does not hide or block the AMC menus or features.
        Default AMC PlanProposed on every new AMC opportunity; also the plan of the draft AMC created from a warranty card (Convert to AMC / AMC Auto-create Mode). Must be an active plan of the company (or shared).
        Default Pricelist (fallback)Visible when pricelists are enabled. The AMC pricelist of a contract is the customer's own pricelist, else a pricelist of the customer's country group, else this fallback. It does not restrict the currency.
        AMC Currency (read-only)Contracts use the currency of their pricelist. Without any applicable pricelist: the currency of the Default Pricelist, else the company currency. Exchange rates come from the standard currency rates.
        Default Billing PlanProposed for new AMC plans (Upfront, Monthly, Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annual, Per Preventive Visit).
        Default Start CriteriaProposed for new AMC plans: Activation Date (coverage starts when the contract is activated) or Manual Start Date (the contract needs a Start Date before its price can be calculated).
        Default Renewal RuleProposed for new AMC plans: Manual, or Auto Offer (a renewal contract is prepared automatically when the contract becomes Expiring).
        Activation TriggerWhen contracts become Active: on Sales Order confirmation, or when the invoice of the first billing period is paid. A plan can override it.
        AMC Service ProductProduct of the AMC quotation lines. Must be a saleable service invoiced on delivered quantities (set manually): one delivered quantity per released billing period.
        Default Alert DaysProposed for new AMC plans: the alert activity of a preventive visit is created this many days before its due date (0 or more).
        AMC Auto-create ModeWarranty Integration: after a warranty card is confirmed, create nothing, a Draft AMC Opportunity or a Draft AMC Contract. The draft is never active (it needs its own quotation / payment) and a failure never blocks the warranty confirmation.
        Offer AMC on Warranty ExpiryWarranty Integration: when a warranty card expires (and has no AMC), its warranty alert users get a to-do to offer an AMC.

        2.2 Billing plans#

        Billing plans (Configuration > Billing Plans) define how the contract value is invoiced: Upfront (once, in advance), Monthly, Quarterly, Half-yearly, Annual (in advance or in arrears) or Per Preventive Visit (in arrears, when each visit is completed).

        2.3 AMC plans#

        An AMC plan (Configuration > AMC Plans) defines the entitlements of every covered unit and the contract rules.

        FieldMeaning
        Service BasisPeriod (visits per month / year) or Usage (a visit every X operating hours, cycles, km…)
        Visit Count (Preventive)Preventive visits per covered unit during the contract, e.g. 3
        Visit FrequencyVisits per month / year, e.g. 3 per Year = a visit every 4 months
        Included Free ServicesOn-demand services per covered unit, separate from the preventive visits
        Visit PlanningAlert-Driven (to-do Alert Days before each due date) or Manual
        Grace Period / Mark Missed After Grace PeriodDays a visit stays Overdue before it is marked Missed (optional)
        Pricing Method / Billing PlanMethod of new formula versions; how the contract is invoiced
        Start Criteria / Contract DurationActivation Date or Manual Start Date; duration in months / years
        Renewal Rule / Renewal NoticeManual or Auto Offer; days before the end when the contract becomes Expiring
        Activation TriggerOverrides the company trigger for this plan
        ApplicabilityPricelists (customer types), products and product categories the plan applies to (empty = all)
        i
        Note

        A plan cannot promise more preventive visits than fit into its duration at its frequency, and Per Preventive Visit billing requires activation on Sales Order confirmation.

        2.4 Pricing formulas#

        Each plan has pricing formula versions (Configuration > Pricing Formulas). Supported methods: Fixed, Per Unit, Per Visit, Percentage of Equipment / Sales Value, Tiered Quantity, Site-Based, Usage-Based and Hybrid (a controlled expression with the variables equipment_value, quantity, visit_count, contract_months, usage, site_count, factor, min_price, max_price and the functions min, max, round, abs).

        1. Create a version, choose the method and enter its rates; optionally Minimum / Maximum Price, Rounding Step, product / category factors and tiers.
        2. Check the Sample section (sample quantity, value, sites, usage) – it shows the calculated sample price and the full breakdown.
        3. Click Activate. An Active version cannot be changed: use New Version (it starts after the current one). Activating a version ends the previous open version the day before.

        Price Preview

        On the plan, Price Preview calculates a price for a customer and sample equipment without creating anything.

        3. Selling an AMC#

        3.1 Opportunities#

        Optional pre-sales follow-up: Sales > Opportunities. Statuses New → Offer Sent → Won (Create Contract) or Lost (with a reason).

        3.2 Creating a contract#

        Sales > Contracts > New: customer, site (service address), AMC plan and the covered equipment (product, serial or warranty unit, whole quantity, site, original equipment value and currency).

        i
        Note

        A serial number or warranty unit can be covered by one open contract only (except the contract and its renewal). The plan must apply to the customer's pricelist and to the products.

        3.3 Calculating the price#

        Click Calculate Price. The formula version in force today is used and converted into the contract currency; the Pricing tab keeps the full snapshot (formula, version, rate, breakdown). Any change of the customer, plan, equipment, start date or expected usage resets the price.

        3.4 Price override#

        Request Override (Coordinator, with a reason) asks for another price or pricelist. An AMC Approver who is not the requester approves or rejects it; the approved price is used for the quotation.

        3.5 Quotation and activation#

        1. Click Create Quotation. A standard Sales quotation is created; its quantity is the number of billing periods. AMC quotation lines cannot be edited, copied or extended.
        2. Send and confirm the quotation in Sales. The price is frozen and the billing schedule is created.
        3. Activation On Sales Order Confirmation: the contract becomes Active at once. On Payment: it becomes Awaiting Payment; create the invoice of the first period, post it and register the payment – the contract is then Active.
        4. On activation the preventive visits (with due dates) and the included free services of every covered unit are generated.
        i
        Note

        An expired quotation cannot be confirmed: use Reissue Quotation on the contract (the price is calculated again for today).

        4. Billing#

        The Billing Schedule tab lists one line per billing period with its dates and amount. Periods are released automatically by the daily scheduler: in advance on the period start, in arrears on the period end, per visit when the visit is completed. A released period is one delivered unit on the Sales Order line.

        1. Click Create Invoice on the contract (or Create Invoice on the Sales Order) to create the draft invoice of the released periods.
        2. Accounting checks, posts and collects the invoice as usual. Nothing is posted or paid automatically.
        i
        Note

        When a contract is closed, periods not yet released are cancelled; invoiced periods are handled in Accounting (credit note if needed).

        5. AMC visits and services#

        5.1 AMC visits#

        Services > AMC Visits lists every entitlement: preventive visits (with due date, or usage due) and included free services. Use the filters Due, Overdue, Planned, Missed and the views list, kanban and calendar.

        StatusMeaning
        PendingAvailable, not yet requested
        ScheduledPlanned, or linked to an AMC service request (warranty case)
        In ProgressIts Service Job is confirmed (Field Service visit created)
        CompletedConsumed once by a completed visit with customer sign-off
        MissedNot serviced within the grace period (if enabled) – an AMC Manager can Reopen it
        ExpiredContract closed or renewed before the visit was used
        CancelledCancelled by an AMC Manager with a reason (not consumed)

        Due indicator: Upcoming before the alert date, Due from the alert date, Overdue after the due date. Alert-Driven plans create a to-do for the contract responsible Alert Days before the due date.

        5.2 Creating a service request#

        1. Select one or more Pending visits of the same contract and site (list view), or open a visit.
        2. Click Create Service Request. Choose Create New (Helpdesk team) or Link Existing ticket and describe the request.
        3. A Helpdesk ticket (tag AMC) and a warranty case of type AMC are created; the visits become Scheduled.
        i
        Note

        Visits of different contracts or sites, visits that are not Pending and visits of contracts that are not Active / Expiring cannot be requested together.

        5.3 Helpdesk, Service Job and Field Service#

        1. Helpdesk ticket: the AMC request; a ticket of the customer shows the Pending AMC Services and Add AMC Services to this Ticket.
        2. Warranty case (AMC): Check Eligibility applies the AMC rules (contract Active or Expiring, request date inside the contract period, visits open), then Approve Case (approver other than the creator / checker).
        3. Prepare Service Job: set the planned date, the main technician (mandatory) and support technicians, then Confirm – the Field Service visit and one worksheet per AMC visit are created; the visits become In Progress.
        4. Field Service visit: the technician records the time, fills the worksheet (usage reading for usage-based visits), collects the customer signature and clicks Complete Visit. The AMC visits are completed automatically (consumed once) and the next due visit is shown on the contract.
        SituationEffect on the AMC visits
        Visit not completed / rescheduledJob and visits stay open, not consumed; a follow-up visit is planned on the job
        Service Job cancelledVisits back to Scheduled on the (Approved) case, not consumed
        Case rejected or closedVisits back to Pending
        No customer sign-off (when required)Completion refused
        i
        Note

        With the Service Execution module, AMC visits can only be completed through their Service Job. Without it, a Coordinator sets the Planned Date and uses Complete on the visit.

        6. Contract lifecycle#

        StatusMeaning / how it is reached
        DraftBeing prepared; equipment and price can change
        QuotationQuotation created; waiting for confirmation
        Awaiting PaymentOrder confirmed; waiting for the payment of the first invoice
        ActiveCoverage running; visits and billing active
        On HoldPut on hold by a Manager (reason): no planning, requests or alerts; dates unchanged
        ExpiringWithin the renewal notice before the end date
        RenewedReplaced by its activated renewal
        ClosedEnded (end date passed or closed by a Manager)
        CancelledCancelled before activation

        6.1 Hold and resume#

        Put On Hold (Manager, reason) on an Active or Expiring contract; Resume returns it to Active (or Expiring). The contract period is not extended.

        6.2 Expiring and renewal#

        The daily scheduler sets Expiring when the renewal notice is reached and creates a to-do. With the Auto Offer rule a renewal Draft is prepared automatically; otherwise click Renew. The renewal copies customer, site, plan and equipment, starts the day after the end date and is priced and sold like a new contract. Sales > Renewals lists expiring contracts and renewals.

        6.3 Closing and cancelling#

        • After the end date the scheduler closes the contract (or marks it Renewed when its renewal is Active). Open visits expire; billing periods not yet released are cancelled.
        • Close Contract (Manager, reason) ends a running contract earlier.
        • Cancel Contract (Manager, reason) is only possible before activation; the quotation is cancelled.

        7. Warranty integration#

        • Convert to AMC on a Confirmed or Expired warranty card creates a Draft AMC contract covering the card's units, linked to the card. It starts the day after the warranty end if that date is still ahead.
        • With AMC Auto-create Mode, a Draft AMC contract or opportunity is created automatically after warranty confirmation (never active).
        • With Offer AMC on Warranty Expiry, a to-do is created when a warranty card expires.
        • The AMC smart button on the card and the Warranty Cards smart button on the contract link both records.

        8. Reports#

        Reporting > AMC Visit Schedule analyses planned, due, overdue, missed and completed visits by AMC plan (type), due month, customer, site and contract status (On Hold, Renewed). Switch between pivot, graph, list, kanban and calendar; export from the list view.

        Print Visit Schedule on a contract prints the PDF of its visits.

        9. Messages and troubleshooting#

        Message (shortened)Cause / what to do
        The price cannot be calculated: …The listed items are missing (plan, equipment, start date for Manual Start plans, plan applicability, serial already covered)
        The price was calculated on …: calculate it againQuotations use today's price – click Recalculate Price
        No quotation …: an override request waits for approvalWait for the AMC Approver decision
        … has no released billing period to invoiceNo period is due yet; check the Billing Schedule
        … cannot be planned: contract … is On HoldResume the contract first
        The AMC visits cannot be requested togetherSelect Pending visits of one running contract and one site
        AMC visits are completed through their Service JobComplete the Field Service visit of the job
        Customer sign-off is requiredUse Sign Report on the Field Service visit
        Only Draft, Quotation or Awaiting Payment contracts can be cancelledUse Close Contract for running contracts
        … already has the renewal …Open the existing renewal (Renewals smart button)

        Scheduled action#

        AMC: Daily Contract and Visit Scheduler (Settings > Technical > Scheduled Actions) runs once a day: billing release, Expiring, end of period, due indicators, alerts and Missed visits. Running it twice changes nothing.
